rows.grounds: compound: vipra-ja (born-of-brahmin) + upavrata (minor-vow) + ardham (half), accusative singular neuter, object of caret
indeclinable particle marking contrast or specification
compound/locative: sakṛt (once) + āgamane (approach, coming), locative singular neuter indicating occasion
optative verb expressing prescribed action, root √car

items.question: What observance is prescribed for a single instance of approach?
premises: The prescribed action is to perform an observance.
The observance is half of the minor vow of one born a brahmin.
This applies in the case of a single approach.
items.inference: Therefore, on a single approach one should perform half of the minor vow prescribed for one born a brahmin.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the 'minor vow' (upavrata) and what constitutes 'approach' (āgamana) in this context is not specified within the verse.
items.plain_english: But on a single approach, one should perform half of the minor vow prescribed for one born a brahmin.
